name: @penguinharness/skilladam-rsi-toolkit
description: SkillAdam RSI Toolkit: evolve a target Skill through trajectory feedback, an evolving issue tracker, paired evaluation and a variance-controlled patch budget. Includes a GDPevo Train/Test workflow.

penguin.description_zh: SkillAdam RSI 工具包：结合执行轨迹、持续更新的问题记录、配对评测和按方差调整的补丁预算，迭代优化目标 Agent 的技能。包含 GDPevo 训练与测试流程。
penguin.short_description: SkillAdam RSI Toolkit: evolve a Skill from execution feedback.
penguin.short_description_zh: SkillAdam RSI 工具包：根据执行反馈迭代技能。

quick_start.prompt: Use the skilladam-rsi-toolkit Skill to optimize a new target gdpevo_skilladam on GDPevo Train. Resolve the training cases, iteration count and execution budget before starting. Use a source-built Penguin install bundle. Report the Skill changes, paired scores and cost. If held-out evaluation is included, run GDPevo Test after optimization is frozen.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用 skilladam-rsi-toolkit 技能在 GDPevo Train 上优化新建的 gdpevo_skilladam Agent。开始前明确训练题集、迭代轮数和执行预算，使用源码构建的 Penguin 安装包。报告技能修改、配对分数与成本；如果实验包含留出评测，在优化结束并冻结技能后运行 GDPevo Test。
